Commentary.Commentary: That it is from this game but do not go anywhere as the action now shifts to Dubai where England will take on Australia. That match starts at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). So switch tabs and enjoy the ride. Cheers!

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that it is quite hard to put into words what has happened in  the last couple of days. Adds that he was a lot of tensed bit also says that David Miller is an experienced batter and he batted really well. Tells that Tabraiz Shamsi is a weapon with the ball and he has been doing well for them. Talking about his wicket, he says that the shot was on but he failed to hit it over the ropes.

The skipper of Sri Lanka, Dasun Shanaka says, Kumara was nailing his yorker’s in the practise session and thought he could pull it off. Credits to the South African batters, for finishing the game well. Mentions, Nissanka will be a real prospect for the future of Lanka cricket. Ends by saying they will hope to win the remaining two games and if they have to leave, they leave with pride.

Tabraiz Shamsi is the Player of the Match, for his brilliant spell with the ball. He says that it is his first Man of the Match trophy but credits David Miller for his outstanding knock today. Adds that he is glad that he is getting regular chances to play now and it has helped him. Tells that he is enjoying his time with this South African side and says that they are one of the best bowling attacks going around in the world.
... Presentation Time ...

Earlier in the day, the South African bowlers did really well to keep Sri Lanka to a low score. The Lankan bowlers though made run scoring really tough. At one stage, they seemed favourites to win it but it was a special knock from Miller which proved to be the difference.

Have to feel sorry for Lanka. They bowled so well for most of the game. Hasaranga was the pick with a three-fer, a hat-trick. Chameera was excellent with the new ball. Kumara too was decent but his last over cost Lanka the game. Also, this is the second successive game where a Sri Lankan spinner has taken a hat-trick and they have ended up on the losing side. This really is a morale deflating loss.

South Africa though struggled throughout the run chase. Then there were a couple of partnerships between Rassie van der Dussen and Temba Bavuma and then Bavuma and Markram but the two stands were broken at the wrong time for the Proteas. Then came the over in which two wickets fell and that pushed South Africa completely onto the back foot. It came down to 15 from the last over and it was their finisher, Miller, who gave them the vital two points.

It seemed like it would be Sri Lanka who would win it when Hasaranga bowled that magical 18th over but there was a Miller special in store. Yes, he did receive help from Rabada but his two sixes in the last over were the crucial hits to get his side over the line.

Cometh the hour, cometh the man. David Miller, you absolute beauty. Take a bow. Whoever was watching, just take a moment, get on your feet and give this man a standing ovation. He keeps South Africa’s dream alive with a scintillating cameo.

FOUR! RABADA SAYS GAME DONE! South Africa have managed the snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. Back of a length, around off. Rabada looks to push it to the off side. The ball takes the outside edge, goes past the keeper and into the boundary at third man. SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE GAME BY 4 WICKETS.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Miller pulls it awkwardly towards square leg and gets a single.

SIX! Oh dear, Miller connects again. We have seen him do it over the years, but under pressure, that is something else. A full-length ball, around middle and leg. Miller clears his front leg and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

SIX! BANG! Miller certainly got hold of that. Pressure back on Sri Lanka. Full and on middle. Miller stays back and hoicks it across the line over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Infact, the ball is send out of the park here.

Rabada takes no time to change the strike. Full, around middle and leg. Rabada looks to heave it away. The ball takes the inner half and goes towards fine leg. They take a single. South Africa would be happy to see David Miller on the strike now.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl the last over.
Full and wide outside off. Rabada slashes it through covers for a single. Rabada to take the strike in the final over.
Full toss, wide outside off. Rabada looks to chase it but misses. It could've gone anywhere, but it only goes to the keeper.

SIX! ALL THE WAY! Rabada says no problem, i'll take care of the boundary. A full-length ball, on off. Chameera misses his yorker by a mark. Rabada clears his front leg and muscles it down the ground for a biggie.
Another single now! South Africa need a boundary in this over to make it easier for them. A length ball, on off. Miller jabs it down the ground to long off for a single.
Full length and on off. Kagiso Rabada pushes it to long off for another single.
Yorker length, around off. Miller hangs back and drills it towards long on for a single.
Floated, around off. Miller pushes it out and takes a single. 25 needed in 12 balls.
Full and on off. Miller works it through mid-wicket for another couple of runs.
Short and on off. Miller pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.

LEG BYE! Not out! Hasaranga could not get his fourth wicket on the trot. It would've been sublime. Loopy ball, around leg. Rabada looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Hasaranga appeals but the umpire says no. They take it upstairs but the impact was outside leg. Rabada survives. The batters get a leg bye in the end.
Review time! Sri Lanka have opted for a review. Kagiso Rabada has been struck on his pads. The Ball Tracker shows that it was pitched outside leg and Sri Lanka lose their review!
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh My God! Wanindu Hasaranga, you legend. He has taken a Hat-Trick. Dwaine Pretorius walks back on a golden duck. Sri Lanka are well on top in this game now. It is all going their way. Loopy ball, full and on off. Dwaine Pretorius lifts it towards long on. Bhanuka Rajapaksa grabs the ball cleanly and Wanindu Hasaranga is up and running in celebration.
Commentary.Howout: c Bhanuka Rajapaksa b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Dwaine Pretorius walks out at number 7.
Dwaine Pretorius walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes right when it mattered the most. Floated, and on off. Bavuma hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Pathum Nissanka near the ropes, leaps and plucks it out of thin air. Wanindu Hasaranga is on a Hat-Trick as he took a wicket on the last ball of his last over.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga comes back to bowl.
A single to end the over! Good-length ball, around leg. Temba Bavuma hangs back and nudges it to deep square leg for one. 31 runs needed off 18 balls!
This is sensible batting from South Africa's skipper! Length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma flicks it to wide of long on and takes a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! Just what South Africa needed at this stage! Chameera hurls a length ball, in the slot, around middle. Temba Bavuma stays back and tonks it way, way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma skips down and looks to slog but he misses.
Leg bye! Short of a length, around leg. David Miller looks to heave it away but the ball hurries onto him and he misses. The ball rolls away to the leg side after brushing his thigh pad. A leg bye!
Good-length ball, on leg. David Miller misses his flick and gets hit high on his pad.
Dushmantha Chameera (2-0-8-2) comes back into the attack.
On a length, around off. David Miller eases it to long off for a run. 41 runs needed off 24 balls now!
A full toss, outside off. Temba Bavuma pushes it to deep cover. A single taken!
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. David Miller stays back and flicks it behind square on the leg side for one. South Africa bring up their 100!
Slightly quicker, around middle. Temba Bavuma tucks it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Flatter ball, on off. David Miller punches it to long off to get off the mark with a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Temba Bavuma drills it to long on for a run.
David Miller comes out to bat now. Also, a bowling change for Sri Lanka. Maheesh Theekshana comes into the attack to bowl his final over.

OUT! BOWLED! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes and he gets the big wicket of Aiden Markram! A huge moment in this game as Markram was the in-form batter! Quicker ball, around off. Aiden Markram stays back to cut but he misses and the ball crashes onto his off stump. Sri Lanka BELIEVE!
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for South Africa! Just a tad short, outside off. Aiden Markram hits it to wide of the long on fielder and collects a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Temba Bavuma tucks it to the leg side for one.
Flatter ball, on a length, on middle. Temba Bavuma heaves it to wide of deep mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs. Had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end Aiden Markram was a goner!
Tossed up, outside off. Temba Bavuma drives hard but finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up, on leg. Aiden Markram drills it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Change.
change
Just a single! A brilliant over by Kumara. Full and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A dot! That will build pressure. A slower one, yorker length, outside off. Markram looks to play it down to long off but misses.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Good change in length! Short and on middle, Bavuma is taken by surprise. He looks to pull but gets a top edge which hits the body and goes towards point.
Markram makes room. This is on middle, he hits it hare to mid off for one.
Good length and on off, this is eased through covers for one more.
Lahiru Kumara (2-0-13-0) is back on.
Good cricket again! Stays back and nudged this on the leg side for one. Good over for the batting side. 59 needed in 42.
On middle, this is whipped down to long on for one. Sensible stuff.
WIDE! Bonus runs. Lanka can't afford this. Down the leg side. Wided.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap and a welcome boundary for South Africa. Way too short. Bavuma rocks back and hammers the ball over mid-wicket. Really good from the South African skipper.
Markram comes down the track, the bowler slows it up, he swings, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A single to end the over! Short ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma hangs back and pulls it straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder. 69 runs needed from 48 balls!
Full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma drives but finds the cover fielder.
Length ball, way outside off. Aiden Markram reaches out and carves it to deep cover for a run.
Length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma prods and works it towards long on. A single taken!
Slower ball, into the pitch, around middle. Temba Bavuma tucks it to wide of long on and takes a couple of runs.
Full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma carves it past the diving cover fielder. The fielder at mid off gives it a chase and keeps it to two.
A touch quicker, around off. Temba Bavuma hangs back and whips it to wide of long on for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Aiden Markram goes back in his crease and eases it to long on for a run.
Another short ball, around middle. Temba Bavuma rocks back and miscues his pull to wide of deep mid-wicket. The batters cross for a run.
A half-tracker, around off. Aiden Markram rocks back and pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Aiden Markram punches it to extra cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Temba Bavuma prods and taps it behind square on the off side for one.

DRINKS! The game is nicely poised at the halfway mark and Sri Lanka would feel that they have their noses slightly ahead after the wicket of Rassie van der Dussen. The Proteas would hope that their in-form batter in Aiden Markram plays a good innings and takes them over the line.
Length and on off. Markram pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Markram has been outstanding in this campign. He is justing continuing on his merry way. A length ball, outside off. Markram stands tall and drives it through extra cover to bag a boundary.
A length ball, on middle. Bavuma nudges it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Good length and outside off. Bavuma comes across and punches it through point. The fielder in the deep, does well to save the boundary. The batters take two.
On a length, around off. Bavuma drives it through covers. The batters pick two easily.
OH CLOSE! Good-length ball, around off. Markram looks to push it to the off side. The ball takes the inside edge, scoots past the stumps and goes towards fine leg. The batters pick up a single.
Flatter and on off. Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off. Markram pushes it to the left of the bowler. Hasaranga dives to that side and saves a run.
Tossed up, around middle, Markram tucks it to mid-wicket but the fielder dives to his left to stop it.
On off, Markram blocks it out.
On middle, Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
Floated, around off. This one spins in a bit. Aiden Markram tucks it to mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Aiden Markram is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Finally a direct hit and Sri Lankan Lions are roaring now. Another one bites the dust in the form of Rassie van der Dussen. A length ball, on off. Bavuma pushes it to cover. Rassie van der Dussen is down the track looking for a single, but was sent back. Dasun Shanaka collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Rassie van der Dussen out of the crease by a long margin, an easy decision for the umpire.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to chase it but misses. Chamika Karunaratne puts in a muted appeal for caught behind, but the umpire signals it as a wide.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to cut it away. He gets an underedge and the ball lands besides the stumps. They take a single.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

Review time! Chamika Karunaratne has convinced Dasun Shanaka to opt for a review! Temba Bavuma has been hit on his pads while trying to scoop it over the keeper's head. The Ball Tracker suggests that the impact is umpire's call so the on-field decision remains.

NOT OUT! Innovation from Temba Bavuma could have gotten him into trouble. A length ball, on off. Bavuma comes across and looks to scoop it over the keeper's head but misses. He gets hit on his pads. Chamika Karunaratne appeals but the umpire says no. They opt to go for the review. The UltraEdge shows the bat is absent. The Ball Tracker shows there is umpire's call on impact which saves the South African skipper.
Full-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it through cover and gets a single.
Fuller length and on middle. Bavuma comes forward and flicks it past mid on for a single.
Floated, around off. Bavuma taps it towards point for a single.
Touch short and on middle. Bavuma stays on the back foot and pulls it to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Googly, around leg. Bavuma looks to heave it across the line. He gets hit on the pads. Hasaranga appeals but the umpire says no.
Another single now! Floated, full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen heaves it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and around off. Bavuma pushes it to cover for a single.
Darted on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to square leg for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes to bowl now.

FIVE RUNS! Overthrows. Free runs for South Africa. Full and on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to mid-wicket. The batters decide to take a run. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. There is no back up behind the stumps. The ball goes through to the boundary at covers.
Full and on middle. Bavuma pushes it to cover and takes a quick single.

A length ball, around off. Bavuma looks to push it to the off side. But the ball takes the inner half and bounces in front of the stumps, Bavuma turns around and looks to kick it away, but the ball ends up landing safely beside the stumps.

Again a tight run! These batters are taking a lot of risk. Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to mid off. The batters take off for a single. The fielder collects the ball and misses his shy at the non-striker's end. If the wickets were hit, Rassie van der Dussen was a goner.
Slower one now. Full, around middle and leg. Bavuma pushes it towards mid on. There is a misfield and the batters sneak a run.
On a length, outside off. Bavuma looks to chase it away but misses. There was not much bounce though this time.
A full toss, on off. Bavuma pushes it towards mid off. The batters take off  for a single. Teh fielder collects the ball but misses his shy at the non-striker's end.
Short of a length, around off. Temba Bavuma blocks it off the back foot.
Full ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives towards mid off. The fielder puts in a dive to his left and saves three runs for his side.

Length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen hits it back to the bowler. Lahiru Kumara collects it and looks to have a shy at the striker's end but he throws it straight back at Rassie van der Dussen. The ball hits him on the pads and Lahiru Kumara puts in an appeal as he thinks Rassie van der Dussen has obstructed the field here. The on-field umpires take it upstairs to check whether it was a case of batter obstructing the field. The third umpire doesn't feel so and it is NOT OUT.

What is happening here. Lahiru Kumara is appealing for something. Kumara had a shy at the striker's end, but it looks like Rassie van der Dussen puts in a bat which means he was obstructing the field. The third umpire says the batter did not have the intention of blocking it. The decision is not out.
The umpires are having a check if Rassie van der Dussen has obstructed the field here.

This is sloppy from Sri Lanka! Good-length ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick run. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. The fielder backing up isn't watching the ball and the batters take one more.
Back of a length, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it behind square on the leg side. Wanindu Hasaranga runs to his right from deep square leg and keeps it to two.
Length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma blocks it off the front foot. 5 runs and 2 wickets off the over!
Well bowled! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Temba Bavuma looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
Temba Bavuma comes out at number 4. He must've not expected to come out so early. But now he has a task in front of him.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Dushmantha Chameera gets the big fish and South Africa are in a spot of bother now! Back of a length, around middle, the ball hurries onto Quinton de Kock as he looks to pull. He gets a top edge and the ball goes high in the air just to the left of de Kock. Dushmantha Chameera calls for it, he runs forward and takes a good catch.
Back of a length, down leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with one.
Rassie van der Dussen comes out at number 3. He has been pushed up the order.
Review time! Reeza Hendricks decides to take it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows there is flat line as the ball passes the blade. The Ball Tracker shows three reds and Reeza Hendricks has to walk back.

OUT! LBW! Dushmantha Chameera strikes and South Africa lose their first wicket! Good-length ball, jagging back in a bit from off. Reeza Hendricks stands tall and looks to work it to the leg side but he misses. He gets hit high on his pad and Dushmantha Chameera puts in an appeal. The umpire raises his finger in no time. Reeza Hendricks decides to review but the Ball Tracker indicates three reds and Hendricks has to walk back.
FOUR! Lucky runs for Reeza Hendricks! Good-length ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks looks to cut but he gets a thick inside edge. The ball goes past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Length ball, around off. Quinton de Kock drives but straight to mid off.
FOUR! Exquisite timing from Quinton de Kock! Length ball, on the pads. De Kock flicks it to wide of the mid on fielder to collect a boundary.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Reeza Hendricks looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards deep square leg. The batters cross for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and blocks it to cover.
Length ball, darted on the pads. Quinton de Kock tucks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Short of a length, around off. Reeza Hendricks looks to drive on the up but it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg. A single taken.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack now. He replaces Dushmantha Chameera.
Quicker ball, on a length, staying a tad low. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and works it to long on for a single. Good over for South Africa as 10 runs came off it.
Flighted delivery, around middle. Quinton de Kock makes room on the off side and lofts it to wide of long off for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Reeza Hendricks eases it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Reeza Hendricks backs away and chips it over cover for a couple.
Floated, around leg. Quinton de Kock flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Tossed up, down leg. Quinton de Kock gets down on his knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Spin time. Maheesh Theekshana to bowl from the other end.
Good-length ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks tucks it to mid-wicket. Just 4 runs off the first over!

Leg bye! Quinton de Kock could not make the most of the Free-Hit! Top delivery from Chameera! He bowls a yorker, around leg. Quinton de Kock misses his flick and gets hit low on his pad. The ball rolls away for a leg bye.
NO BALL! That spoils a good over as Dushmantha Chameera oversteps. Good-length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it back to the bowler. Free Hit coming up!
Hendricks gets off the mark now! Good-length ball, darted on the pads. Reeza Hendricks flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Another ball, shorter in length, around middle. Reeza Hendricks nudges it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks taps it to backward point.
South Africa and Quinton de Kock are up and running! Back of a length, on leg. Quinton de Kock tucks it to the leg side for a single.
